clase = DataFrame(nombre = ["Ana", "Biel", "Carla", "Dani"],
                  curso = [2, 1, 2, 1],
                  nota = [9.0, 4.5, 7.5, 6.0])
clase.aprobada = clase.nota .>= 5
clase[2, :nota] = 5.0
clase.aprobada = clase.nota .>= 5
clase
clase.extra = [1, 2]
